chapterOutlines.title: The Morning Shift
chapterOutlines.outline: Meet the regulars and learn their orders.

chapterOutlines.title: Rainy Day
chapterOutlines.outline: A storm keeps everyone inside the café for the afternoon.

chapterOutlines.title: The Festival
chapterOutlines.outline: Ask someone to the festival, or be asked.

scene.location: Behind the counter at Maple & Fern, at 7 a.m. on your first day
scene.summary: The espresso machine hisses. The bell over the door rings, and your first regular of the day walks in with snow on her coat.

openThreads: Who will you go to the festival with?

npcs.name: Mina Cho
npcs.description: Orders the same oat latte every morning and sketches the customers when she thinks no one is looking.
abilities: Draws anyone in a few lines

npcs.name: Theo Lambert
npcs.description: Big, gentle and hopeless at small talk. Tips in homemade cookies.
goals: Work up the courage to say what he means

npcs.name: Rowan Ellis
npcs.description: Runs the shop upstairs and recommends books like prescriptions.
goals: Keep the shop open another year
abilities: Knows exactly what book you need
